notes.title: New demo event until January 1st! Now with controller support!
notes.content:
You can try a brand new, updated demo as part of DreamHack Beyond! 

New features, updated visuals and now with controller support!

The demo will be live until January 1st. 

Enjoy and share your cool beats!

notes.title: You have one week left to try the demo
notes.content:
We thank all players who tried our demo, we received a lot of valuable feedback, but it's time for us to retire the current version. 

You can still play it for one week, we'll retire the demo on the 6th of September. 
It's been awesome watching you play, and reading all your feedbacks, the demo exceeded our expectaions! 

We are hard at work on the final game so stay tuned for further updates!

notes.title: Concert Rework
notes.content:
We're excited to show you the reworked concert system! 
Based on your feedback we managed to make the concerts a lot more fun, let's take a look how they work now: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43577595/2cf655435c5efb1bc4ee39fb583157084611dcee.png[/img]

We decided to remove the "Vibe progress" bar, and replace it with separate vibe bars for each color. 
This made the concerts much clearer for our playtesters, you no longer have to wait for hints, and you no longer have to randomly guess what they could like. 

We also introduced multiple levels in a concerts - indicated by the black boxes under the bars. 
To make concerts a bit longer, but not tedious, there are now multiple levels to them. Each with their own unique needs, that you have to make.

We received a lot of positive feedback about this new system, you can go try it now in our demo!


Thanks for all your feedback!
